title: Auto String Farm
description: A compact Fabric block that automatically produces string without building a complicated technical string farm.
body:
# Auto String Farm

Have you ever been frustrated by how annoying traditional technical string farms can be to set up? Direction, layout, water flow, entities, and space constraints can make a simple need for string feel unnecessarily complicated.

Auto String Farm adds a compact and simple alternative: a craftable block that automatically produces Minecraft string.

## Features

- Adds the Auto String Farm block
- Produces 2 string per second
- Has a 27-slot internal inventory
- Stops producing when full
- Supports hopper extraction
- Can be opened like a small container
- Mineable with an axe
- Includes its own creative mode tab

## Recipe

```text
Wooden Trapdoor  String  Wooden Trapdoor
Tripwire Hook    String  Tripwire Hook
Water Bucket     Chest   Water Bucket
